_readme: Daily Sales Check settings (python -m dsc). Every threshold lives here; change it here, never in code. Working days come from config/months/YYYY-MM.json (shared with Part Wise).
_teams_note: Amit's teams (5 Nov 2026). Never report other teams.
_targets_note: team_members_data_amit. Column 'Month' = first of the month (DD/MM/YYYY). Only Status = Active rows with a Target count. Team target = sum of its callers' targets.
_lead_roles_note: Designations treated as team leaders: their revenue counts in the team total, but they are not ranked as callers and not flagged in early warning.

refresh._note: Before the run both dashboards must have refreshed after 11:30 IST today (the revenue sheet is complete about 11:30). If not, the run starts a refresh of each and waits up to wait_minutes.

run_rate._note: Check 2. Daily run-rate = monthly target / working days in the month. A team is flagged with zero revenue on the previous working day, or revenue below run-rate x min_pct/100.

early_warning._note: Check 3. Periods are parts of the month (1-10, 11-20, 21-end; Amit 5 Nov 2026). For each of the last completed parts, a caller's number is off track when it is below off_track_pct_of_benchmark % of the team benchmark (median of the team's callers that week). Flagged when off track weeks_running parts in a row (the key keeps its old name). Team revenue is off track when a part's revenue is below that part's target (target / working days x working days in the part).

mtd._note: Check 4. MTD achievement = MTD revenue / (monthly target x N / D), N = day of month, D = days in the month: the MTD Revenue Analysis rule, so both reports show the same % (Amit, 10 Nov 2026). prorate 'working_days' would use working days instead. Flag below min_pct after day after_day. Daily run-rate and 'needed per working day' still use working days.

leads._note: Check 5. A high-intent lead = a phone whose latest stage in the last lookback_days is one of 'stages' (LSQ stage report + Team Uzair LSQ live sheet), not enrolled this month or last (BASE DATA 'New enrollment'). Untouched = no call to that number by anyone for more than untouched_hours before the latest call in the data. Held by the caller who set the stage.

top_bottom._note: Check 6. Ranked by MTD achievement of pro-rated target; callers with no target and team leaders are not ranked.

root_cause._note: For every flagged caller, each funnel step is compared with the benchmark: the median of the team's top 3 callers by MTD revenue. A step below gap_pct % of the benchmark is a gap; the first gap in funnel order is the primary reason.

followup_level._note: Follow-ups per active day vs the team median (callers, not team leaders): at or above high_pct % = High, below low_pct % = Low, else Medium. Source: LSQ 'Follow Up For Closure' stage changes (stage report + Team Uzair LSQ sheet). Zipteams call data is not wired in yet.

lsq_budget_minutes._note: Most minutes each LSQ read may take, so the 12:00 report is never held up. The run notes say when a budget was reached.

zipteams._note: Zipteams writes a 'Zipteams Notes' activity (237) to the lead in LSQ after each call; intent in mx_Custom_1 = HIGH / MODERATE / NEUTRAL / LOW / NOT_AVAILABLE (as in the sales_automation_01 project). Notes of the last 'days' days are read. A follow-up takes the intent of the lead's latest note from match_days before to match_days after the follow-up date (matched by Prospect ID). Zipteams intent is one input, never the answer.

trend._note: Parts of the month as in Part Wise: 1-10, 11-20, 21-end (Amit, 5 Nov 2026: weeks were confusing). The last 'parts' parts are shown.

_drive_note: Team performance & Reports > Team Uzair Performance (Amit) > Daily Sales Check (created on the first run). One PDF and one xlsx per run date, replaced if re-run.
